Thanks for contributing to AGS!

A few things worth checking before you post:

  - Is your branch based on the right branch of our repository? See
    "Branch Organization and Releases" in CONTRIBUTING.md.
  - Bug fixes and small improvements can be sent straight away. For new
    features or larger changes, please open an issue first so that we can
    discuss the approach.
  - Does each commit build, and is each one about a single thing?
    See "Commits".

None of the sections below are compulsory. Fill in what is useful for the

## Summary
<!-- What does this change, and why? If it adds or alters a script API,
     showing the declaration and a short example helps a lot. -->

## Related issues
<!-- For example: "Fixes #1234", "Resolves #601". Delete if there are none. -->

## Testing
<!-- How did you check that this works? Tests you added, games or rooms you
     tried it on, platforms you built for. If something could not reasonably
     be covered by a test, say so here and describe how you verified it by
     hand instead. -->

## Notes for reviewers
<!-- Optional. Anything you are unsure about, decisions you would like a
     second opinion on, known gaps, or things deliberately left for later. -->

## AI tooling
<!-- If you used AI tooling to write any of the code in this pull request,
     please say so here: which tool, and what you used it for. A sentence is

     We ask for this so that reviewers know where to look more carefully. It
     is not held against a contribution. See "Use of AI Tooling" in

     Delete this section if you did not use any. -->
